DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 86-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
